prompt: Stage 4-1, level 7 with 20 gold, 61 HP, board is fine but not scaling. Next round (4-2) is an augment round. You have 12 XP to level 8. Do you level now?

options.label: Level to 8 now (12 gold) and roll the remaining 8 for 4-costs
Hold. Take the 4-2 augment, then level and roll with ~30 gold

explanation:
Leveling at 4-1 with 20 gold gives you level 8 odds with 8 gold to spend: two rolls. That is not a rolldown; it is a hope. At 4-2 you gain the augment, 5 base income plus interest and the win/loss gold, so you enter the round with roughly 30 gold and, more importantly, you know which augment you took. An augment that gives gold, XP or a component changes what the level-8 rolldown is for. Leveling before you see it means committing to a plan the augment might overrule.

The board has enough 2-stars to survive one more round of a 1-loss streak at 61 HP. Rolling at 7 for 3-cost upgrades is worst: you are already 2-starred where it matters and 3-cost odds at 7 mostly find units you cannot fit.
principle: Around an augment round, level after the augment, not before it.
commonMistake: Treating "level 8 at 4-1" as a rule rather than as "level 8 with enough gold to roll".
